messages:
Jen (Partnerships): Big win — LumenSIS signed as an ISV partner and pushed a Marketplace listing. They also agreed to a Private pilot (VPC + KMS) starting next week. More details below.
Omar: heck yea!! :tada: huge congrats team.
Sara (CS): Amazing. I created the onboarding checklist in Notion: /notion/lumensis-onboarding. Kickoff meeting scheduled.
Marcus (Marketing): Love it. Can we get a one-sentence customer quote and a short case highlight? @Jen can you intro to their CPO so we can request a blurb?
Jen (Partnerships): Intro sent to Priya (CPO) in DM and via email. Customer contact: Priya Kaur <pri...@lumensis.com>. Contract ref: `LUM-2026-01` (signed 2026-03-10).
Tara (Sales): Marking as ISV strategic deal. ARR flagged at ~$250k year1, upsell motion planned for Dedicated in Q4.
Legal Bot: MSA + DPA reviewed; redlines accepted. Final contract stored at `s3://contracts/lumensis/LUM-2026-01.pdf`.
deploy-bot: Marketplace listing published -> https://marketplace.aws.amazon.com/listing/lumensis (status: ACTIVE) :rocket:
Liam (Eng): For Private pilot we need: VPC peering, KMS handshake, skip cert rotation for first 30d, and extra metrics. Created Jira `RED-4888` and assigned to @Liam.
Sara (CS): CS kickoff Wed 10am PT — calendar invite sent to internal + customer attendees. Agenda: milestones, success metrics, escalation path.
Jen (Partnerships): Marketing — pls draft a short announcement and a 1-pager. Marcus can you own the PR draft? :memo:
Marcus (Marketing): Yep. Draft PR uploaded: /drive/PR-LumenSIS-draft.md. @Jen please review by Mon EOD.
Omar: Shoutout to infra & legal for the quick turn. team dinner friday? 🍕
Jen (Partnerships): Adding ask: if anyone has pilot perf numbers (latency, cost delta) drop them here for the case study.
Liam (Eng): Quick numbers from our bench: ~2.4x throughput vs their self-hosted baseline after batching, ~38% cost reduction with quantization + caching. Will validate under pilot load.
Sara (CS): Those are gold for the case study. Thanks @Liam.
Priya (LumenSIS): Excited to partner with Redwood — happy to provide a quote after the pilot completes and share initial performance feedback.
Marcus (Marketing): Once we have Priya quote, we'll sync with comms + marketplace team for a coordinated announcement next week.
Jen (Partnerships): Approved. I'll finalize the internal case study draft and ping product for any architecture diagrams.
Omar: Awesome. Great teamwork everyone. :clap:
Jen (Partnerships): I'll update the partner tracker and close this thread. If anything blocks, flag it in #eng-oncall or ping me directly. Thanks!
